cover.coreProposition: Resource managers should establish one canonical owned population before lifecycle side effects and reuse one documented identity relation across connect, retry and cleanup; deduplication and serialized mutation improve in-process accounting but do not establish endpoint uniqueness or distributed exactly-once execution.
cover.visualMetaphor: Several overlapping resource rings enter a precise aperture and emerge as one ordered set before touching a mechanical lifecycle surface
cover.semanticObject: A compact canonical set held inside a single ownership frame
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with layered circular forms converging before one physical threshold, dark green and copper palette, crisp silhouette and large negative space
